picks.editorial_note: A strategic partnership between CERN and Mistral to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated particle collisions marks one of the most ambitious applications of AI to fundamental physics research to date.

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, discussed at the National Academy of Engineering's annual meeting, represents a national-scale effort to link supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities for AI-accelerated discovery — a significant policy and infrastructure commitment.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced consortium of 14+ universities building shared advanced computing infrastructure signals a coordinated federal push on AI/supercomputing capacity at regional scale.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: UIUC's ESMDynamic model dramatically speeds up prediction of protein motion compared to traditional molecular dynamics simulations, a meaningful advance for structural biology and drug discovery pipelines.
picks.title: AI model offers a faster way to explore how proteins move, study finds

picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's machine learning tool for estimating radiation exposure from routine blood tests offers a practical, scalable alternative to specialized biodosimetry — valuable for both medical and emergency-response contexts.
picks.title: A Simple Blood Test Could Reveal Hidden Radiation Exposure

picks.editorial_note: The Purdue-Google summit builds on a multiyear partnership spanning cloud infrastructure and research to advance physical AI in manufacturing, reflecting growing industry-academia alignment on workforce-ready AI deployment.
